title: LOOK: Cambodian PM, Russian foreign minister arrive for 49th ASEAN Summit
summary: Cambodian Prime Minister Samdech Moha Borvor Thipadei Hun Manet arrived in Manila early Tuesday, November 17, to attend the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

blocks.text: Cambodian Prime Minister Samdech Moha Borvor Thipadei Hun Manet arrived in Manila early Tuesday, November 17, to attend the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
He was the last Southeast Asian leader to arrive in the Philippines, as Cambodia had just concluded its hosting of the 20th Francophonie Summit on Monday.
Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Viktorovich Lavrov also arrived in the Philippines later Tuesday morning.
He was welcomed by Department of Energy Secretary Sharon Garin.
The 49th ASEAN Summit began on Sunday, November 15, and will conclude on Tuesday.

President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. earlier said the summit provides an opportunity to address various challenges facing the region, including transnational crimes such as human trafficking, cybercrime and online scams.
It also offers an avenue to discuss ways to strengthen maritime cooperation, he added.
Among the notable developments during the summit was the signing of the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement, described as the first agreement of its kind in the world.— MCG, GMA News
